c1.title: Closing a diastema with veneers
c1.summary: A central diastema and peg-shaped lateral incisors, resolved with four ceramic veneers after preliminary whitening.

c2.title: Single implant in the aesthetic zone
c2.summary: An unrestorable lateral incisor replaced with a delayed-loading implant and an all-ceramic crown.

c3.title: Moderate crowding with aligners
c3.summary: Crowding of the lower arch corrected in eleven months with clear aligners and a fixed retainer.

c4.title: Full-arch implant rehabilitation
c4.summary: An upper arch compromised by advanced periodontitis, rehabilitated with a fixed restoration on six implants.

c5.title: Rebuilding wear from bruxism
c5.summary: Generalised wear of the anterior teeth rebuilt with adhesive restorations and a night guard.

c6.title: Deep bite in adolescence
c6.summary: Corrected with fixed appliances and intermaxillary elastics, followed by night-time retention.

c7.title: Sinus lift and two implants
c7.summary: Posterior upper region with insufficient bone, treated with a sinus lift and fixed rehabilitation.

c8.title: Endodontic retreatment and inlay
c8.summary: A molar with an apical lesion retreated under the microscope and rebuilt with a ceramic inlay.
